correctness.rationale: The reverse frontier recursion Z_k|F_k~Bin(Y_k,1/k), Y_(k-1)=Y_k-Z_k+2 1_{Z_k>0} telescopes to X=2Y_m-1+D-E. Janson finite-model with-replacement flatness and Gamma(2,1) amplitude apply at m>>sqrt n, covering n^(2/3). A second-hit probability is binom(Yk,2)/k² plus summable O(n³/k^6) error; accumulated internal intensity ->xi²/(6c³), and triples vanish. Root endpoints are fresh iid uniform; birthday repeats have Le Cam proxy intensity Y_m²/(2m)->xi²/(2c³), with summed adapted error O(Y_m³/m²). Independent fresh uniform proxy couplings yield limiting conditional independence, not finite independence. Expectation O(n²/m³) bounds prove zero-collision supercritical side. Independent full 14,400 multigraph enumerations at n=6,m=2 and smaller n verify exact X identity/distributions; cannot prove weak convergence.
